facts.fact: The World Bank, quoted by The Sun, puts Nigeria's national fibre backbone at about 35,000 km, to be extended to 125,000 km by Project BRIDGE; dated to the article's publication date as it gives no other.

systems.country_label: Project BRIDGE (Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth)
systems.owner: Bridge Open Access SPV, government minority stake

note: BRIDGE start is announced for October, so not building; open-access is a design recommendation, not a stated service.
